verdict.rationale: Brex has a Travel product combining global booking inventory with auto-enforced policies on one platform (brex-docs-39). The changelog says booking objects expose whether a booking was out of policy and which travel policy rules it broke (brex-docs-6), so policy is evaluated on the booking itself. A community user also confirms using Brex Travel (brex-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit mention of flights and hotels as bookable inventory, documentation that out-of-policy bookings are blocked or routed for approval at booking time rather than only flagged, and in-depth travel docs or hands-on reports of policy enforcement during booking.
